parameters.event_body_mix: adds band-limited combustion_event layer content (stem-derived additive)
parameters.forced_carrier_reduction: subtracts high-passed forced_induction layer content (stem-derived subtractive)

AA-C1.location_in_chain: post transfer_ir, pre PTR (the entire layers['pre_ptr'] output)

Classified STATE_DEPENDENT_BROAD_PRE_PTR_SCALING.
